name: Hunt the Savages
summary: Huntsman Markhor, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, calls the savage owlbeasts some of the region's most ornery creatures and asks you to kill twenty of them.

sections.title: Claws and Beaks
sections.body: Markhor describes the savage owlbeasts as among the more ornery creatures of the Hinterlands, and says the claws and beaks of the beasts have cost Revantusk many good warriors. Markhor wants every one you see killed, until you can bear no more bloodshed, and then the contribution you made will be weighed and judged. Twenty must fall.

sections.title: Clearing the Mind
sections.body: Markhor's counsel for the hunt is to clear the mind of unclean thoughts and join with the wild. The owlbeasts are out in the Hinterlands wilds.

sections.title: Markhor's Judgment
sections.body: After the hunt, Markhor names you a worthy friend to the Revantusk.

faq.answer: Huntsman Markhor, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why does Markhor want the savage owlbeasts killed?
faq.answer: Markhor calls them ornery and says they have claimed many good Revantusk warriors with their claws and beaks.

faq.q: Where can the savage owlbeasts be found?
faq.answer: Markhor says they dwell in the Hinterlands wilds.

faq.q: How many savage owlbeasts must be slain?

attribution: Classic quest text: Hunt the Savages
